description: Open the TCP sample capture file (200722_tcp_anon.pcapng) located at /home/ga/Documents/captures/200722_tcp_anon.pcapng in Wireshark. Use the Statistics > Endpoints menu to view endpoint statistics. Find the IPv4 endpoint that sent the most bytes (highest 'Tx Bytes' column). Save a text file at /home/ga/Documents/captures/top_talker.txt containing ONLY the IP address of the top sender (e.g. '192.168.1.100').
